title: 0cular contract
description: A 0cular contract (apiVersion 0cular/v1alpha1): the rules a candidate version of an artifact must meet before it's published. 0cular checks a few things this schema can't, such as unique check names.

apiVersion.description: The contract format. This schema describes 0cular/v1alpha1.

metadata.description: Identifies the artifact the contract governs.

name.description: The artifact's name: 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, such as bot-features.

artifact.description: The artifact's format, and the caps that apply when decoding it.

maxBytes.description: The largest artifact allowed, checked before decoding: a whole number of bytes, or a whole number followed by B, KiB, MiB or GiB, such as 5MiB.

maxDepth.description: How deeply the artifact's values may nest: {"a": [1]} nests 2 deep. At most 10000, the deepest nesting the JSON and YAML parsers read.

maxNodes.description: How many values the artifact may hold, after YAML aliases are expanded.

schema.description: The JSON Schema the artifact must match.

jsonSchema.description: The path of a Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema file, relative to the contract file and written with forward slashes, such as schemas/bot-features.schema.json. The schema must be one self-contained file, with no references to other files or URLs.

invariants.description: Rules on the candidate alone, written in CEL. A false result or an error blocks the candidate. Absolute limits belong here.

diffBudgets.description: Limits on how much the candidate may change from the baseline. A breach needs approval, unless the budget isn't overridable, in which case it blocks.

onFailure.description: What a loader does when a version fails. With a last known good, every failure keeps it; the policy applies only without one.

noLastKnownGood.description: What a loader does when it has no last known good: closed refuses to start, and open starts with a default value the application provides.

trustLastKnownGood.description: Whether a loader keeps a cached last known good that fails re-validation against the current contract.

name.description: 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

overridable.description: Whether an approval can accept a breach. If it can't, a breach blocks the candidate.

stale.description: With a last known good, every failure keeps it, so stale is the only value.

name.description: Identifies the rule in reports and metrics. Each check in a contract needs its own name.

expr.description: A CEL expression that must be true, such as size(self.features) <= 200.

message.description: Why the rule exists. Reports show it when the rule fails.

diffBudget.description: A measure budget compares one value computed from both versions; a collection budget compares two keyed lists.

name.description: Identifies the budget in reports and metrics. Each check in a contract needs its own name.

measure.description: A CEL expression evaluated on the candidate and on the baseline, such as size(self.features).

name.description: Identifies the budget in reports and metrics. Each check in a contract needs its own name.

collection.description: A CEL expression for a list, evaluated on the candidate and on the baseline, such as self.policies.

key.description: A CEL expression over item that identifies each element, such as item.id.

maxRemoved.description: Limits how many keys the candidate drops.

maxAdded.description: Limits how many keys the candidate adds.

maxChangedPct.description: Limits the percentage of the baseline's elements whose value changes.
